label: Public AI's published terms: the facts the documents state about the review-mode route through the Public AI gateway (who runs it, under which jurisdiction, with or without a processing agreement, where inference runs), recorded by hand from the provider's pages; quotations verbatim

provider.name: Metagov Inc
provider.quote: the nonprofit 501(c)(3) Metagov Inc; We are a US-based nonprofit.

quotes: Localized data storage outside the US
We do not offer service-level agreements (SLAs)

model_providers_quote: act as independent controllers of your data; no Data Processing Agreements are in place. (§2.9)

routing.quote: Our Services may route Prompts and related data to external providers (§1.5); A global load-balancing layer ensures that requests are routed efficiently and transparently, regardless of which country's compute is serving the query. (utility page)

assessment.why: the provider is US-based, routes requests across other countries' compute and offers no processing agreement, so a body sending document text through the gateway discloses it abroad without one; with the local 8B no document text leaves the machine
